description: Email and DNS setup only, for 1-5 domains. Use this when you need to check email deliverability or spoofing protection, or to see which email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365…) a company uses. Does not fetch the website (use tech_stack) or registration data (use domain_registration). Input: domains (1-5 domains, URLs or email addresses). Returns results[] with, per domain: exists; email (MX hosts and provider, SPF record and its all qualifier, DMARC policy, pct and rua); dns (A/AAAA/NS records); verifications (services proven by TXT site-verification tokens, e.g. google, apple, atlassian); errors, analyzedAt and cached. Limits: each domain counts as one lookup; answers cached for 1 hour per domain; 25 free domains a day per IP without a key, more with a paid key in the x-api-key header. Read-only: nothing is stored, no email is sent.
